description: Submit an enterprise IP whitelist request to raise the daily unpaid compilation quota from 3 jobs/24h up to 25-100 jobs/day for a shared corporate NAT or CI/CD runner IP. Call when calligraphy_compile_board returns HTTP 429 rate-limit errors. Requires customer_email, organization_name, and reason; returns JSON request_id and status. Example: organization_name='Apex Robotics'.

client_ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to whitelist (auto-resolved over HTTP).

customer_email.description: Corporate work email address of engineering lead requesting quota.

organization_name.description: Legal organization or hardware team name behind shared IP.

reason.description: Brief engineering justification for higher daily compilation quota limit.

requested_daily_limit.description: Requested maximum daily compilations per 24h window (10 to 100).

name: calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist
title: Request Enterprise IP Whitelist Quota
